about_the_game:
Introducing a must-listen original soundtrack that celebrating the grand finale of FFBE.

FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS Original Soundtrack Vol.4, featuring all 15 in-game BGM tracks featured in anniversary special story and season five, is now available. This collection of epic tracks by Noriyasu Agematsu, Seima Kondo, Ryota Tomaru, and Junpei Fujita, is perfectly suited for the grand finale of the story.

Enjoy this must-listen album dedicated to those who stayed with FFBE until the very end of its epic story.
